# Bid the wells, the pit, and the discharge.

> Price an interior French drain, exterior excavation, or crawl encapsulation from perimeter, wall height, window wells, crack repair, sump pit, backup pump, and freeze-protected discharge — not a published price per lineal foot. See the walk-away number before you match a cheaper drain-tile quote.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
